thread:
elaine: Quick syncwe have inconsistent param naming in examples (`model` vs `model_name`) and mixed use of "latency" wording. Proposal: use `model` in public SDK examples, keep `model_name` only in schema/db docs, and prefer "response latency" when referring to end-to-end measurements.

mike: I can update JS/Py snippets and add a small examples README note. Will mark legacy schemas in comments (use "legacy" not "deprecated").

samira: Agree. Please avoid the word "deprecated" in customer-facing snippets until formal deprecation. I'll review wording for customer-facing pages.

toni: I'll add a one-sentence glossary entry and a short voice note: "Use concise, neutral phrasing; avoid promotional language."

docs-bot: New PR by mike: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/4729 snippet fix + examples readme

mike: Added a tiny docs CI lint to flag mixed param names in examples.

samira: LGTM; one tiny nit: change any ambiguous "latency" -> "response latency" where appropriate.

elaine: Thanks  plan: samira approves snippets, toni merges glossary, mike merges examples, then I'll post a short note in #release-notes.
